It tags 18 PII entity types (73 BIOES classes) at token level and is intended as the NER layer of a multi-layer PII-masking gateway in front of LLM services — behind a regex backstop for fully structured ...

sources.title: BCCard/MoAI-Privacy-Filter-INT8 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: 1. Overview This repository provides the INT8 weight-only ONNX Runtime serving artifact for a Korean/English PII detection model for the finance domain. The model was built by full fine-tuning openai/privacy-filter - a 1.4B-parameter MoE with 50M active parameters - on synthetic finance-domain PII data. It tags 18 PII entity types using 73 BIOES token classes at token level.
